beforeRow.evidenceNote: Current Mazda Australia HTML names GT and Azami. The manufacturer retains preorder/almost-here advertising and links to dealer enquiry. Its current driveaway offer separately identifies E35 GT. Melville Mazda advertises one New E35 Azami GR, stock 11397703/VIN LVRHDCEK6TN551337, with public in_stock/reserved=false/preorder=false metadata last updated 6 October 2026. These seller fields do not establish present unsold physical availability. No detailed specification or brochure-to-VIN applicability is admitted.
limitations: GT and Azami are manufacturer HTML grade names observed on 12 October 2026. This is not a complete closed build/configuration universe. E35 GT occurs in manufacturer offer HTML; E35 Azami GR is the exact seller label, not independent manufacturer-to-VIN specification verification.

Manufacturer preorder advertising links to dealer enquiry. Accepted orders, production, allocation and completed deliveries remain unverified; the earlier September delivery forecast is not proof of fulfilment.

Seller New/in_stock, reserved=false, preorder=false and sold_date=null are published claims for one advertisement. The record was last updated on 6 October; retrieval on 12 October does not guarantee same-day inventory freshness, unsold physical stock or any GT stock.
Formal manufacturer model year and exact build applicability remain unverified. Seller year/model_year 2026 and build/compliance dates are not promoted into manufacturer model year.

The root visually inspected brochure pages 5, 7 and 14, confirming grade table headings, cargo measurement basis and the publication footer/code. This limited visual check does not approve the separate detailed technical candidate; no technical epoch or specification is admitted by this market record.

Cargo remains an unresolved attributed conflict: PDF extraction says 363 L VDA seats-up to tray/seatback including underfloor; model HTML advertises 468 L without a measurement protocol. Preserve both; no normalized seats-up value or ranking.
GT advertised driveaway-from pricing, historical April manufacturer-list pricing and the seller enquiry-only price have distinct bases. No final customer price or free vehicle is established.
Ranking and complete-current-vehicle eligibility remain false. This changes one existing lead disposition; it does not close the wider market audit or add a detailed catalogue variant.
